pickFieldHint: Pick a field to browse its satellite scene catalog.
title: Scene catalog
description: Discover, acquire and track satellite scenes for the selected field. This page is catalog + acquisition status only — no index values are rendered here.
provenanceNote: Provenance: discovery queries the public NASA CMR STAC catalog; the product is NASA HLS (harmonized Landsat 8/9 + Sentinel-2 surface reflectance, 30 m). Acquiring a scene reads its cloud-optimized GeoTIFF assets and derives vegetation indices (e.g. NDVI). Imagery courtesy of the NASA HLS pipeline and the U.S. Geological Survey / Copernicus programs — attribution required.
discoveryDesc: Search the public catalog for scenes covering this field within the date range and cloud limit.
invalidRange: Start date must be on or before the end date.
operatorRequired: Discovering and acquiring scenes requires an Operator role or higher in your organization.
catalogDesc: Every scene known for this field, with its acquisition status.
readyHint: Ready scenes never show index values here — their vegetation indices live in Crop Intelligence (satellite intelligence views).
emptyCatalog: No scenes in the catalog for this field yet.
emptyCatalogHint: Run discovery for this field and date range to list matching scenes.
loadError: Could not load the scene catalog.
